title: NRO Sentient program integrated with Immaculate Constellation

tellings.quote: the sentient program would have come online to my understanding after like you know immaculate constellation had already existed but would have been integrated with it

plain: A program called Sentient at the National Reconnaissance Office, the agency that runs America's spy satellites, came online after another secret program called Immaculate Constellation already existed and was then "integrated with it", according to Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official presented on the show as a whistleblower. Brown tells Michels this as "my understanding", without pointing to a document. If so, a spy-satellite system would be feeding the hidden program he describes.
